description: This Java class 'SearchSourceBuilder' constructs 'SearchSource' objects for performing search queries within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages search parameters such as filters, sorting, fields, namespaces, and timeouts, and validates options and filter expressions.

classes.name: SearchSourceBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing SearchSource objects with configurable search parameters, validation, and option parsing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a SearchSource object after validating and assembling search parameters.

methods.name: pubSubMediator
methods.description: Sets the pub-sub mediator actor reference.

methods.name: conciergeForwarder
methods.description: Sets the concierge forwarder actor reference.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets the search result fields either directly or from a comma-separated string.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Sets and validates the filter expression for the search.

methods.name: namespaces
methods.description: Sets the search namespaces either directly or from a comma-separated string.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets the sort option from a string, considering default sort.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Sets the sort options from a comma-separated string.

methods.name: sortValues
methods.description: Sets the sort values for cursor-based pagination.

methods.name: dittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers including authorization and correlation info.

methods.name: thingsAskTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for asking the things shard region.

methods.name: searchAskTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for asking the search actor.

methods.name: lastThingId
methods.description: Sets the last thing ID for resuming search.
